key_insight: The Generalized Mean-Field Ising (GMFI) family combines dense, inhomogeneous interactions with exactly solvable ground states, enabling scalable benchmarks for quantum and classical optimization.
engineering_relevance: Exact reference solutions allow optimization methods to be evaluated at system sizes beyond the reach of exact diagonalization.
method: Derive exact ground states using hidden low-dimensional structure.
Classify system sizes and ground-state degeneracies through number theory.
Evaluate quantum annealing, QAOA, imaginary-time evolution, and classical or quantum-inspired heuristics.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical analysis and D-Wave experiments, highlighting pronounced system-size-dependent oscillations in the quantum-annealing gap.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative performance comparisons, so it does not establish quantum advantage or generalization to other optimization problems.
paper_title: Generalized Mean-Field Ising Model as a Benchmark Family with Exact Solutions
